issues.issue: Whether the new documents filed on appeal are admissible under IRPA subsection 110(4).
issues.applicant_position: She sent the documents to the RAD believing they were new evidence.
issues.result_text: New documents not accepted: they predate rejection unexplained, or are irrelevant or unexplained.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in assessing the appellant's credibility.
issues.applicant_position: Submits the RPD erred in assessing credibility; details to be discussed if necessary.
issues.result_text: RPD's three elements are insufficient to reject credibility; RAD finds the RPD erred.

issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative in Mexico is available.
issues.result_text: Cannot determine internal flight alternative without the hearing evidence; matter referred to the RPD.
